function_v0.doc: `[id_this, id_market(this, data), id_collateral(token)...]` for every collateral\ntoken of the pool. Reads the pool the first time (`MarketSynced`).
function_v0.name: ids

function_v0.doc: Keeper only. Precept has no rewards to claim, so this records nothing; it emits\n`Harvest` so the trait is the same as for strategies that do. `data` is ignored.
function_v0.name: harvest

function_v0.doc:
Supplies `assets`, pulled from the vault, to the pool and credits the vault with the
b-tokens the pool minted. `data` must be the pool's XDR (`InvalidData` otherwise).
`change` is the position's value now minus the value last recorded for it. The
protocol total grows by `assets`, the principal put in (Q89), less what the
position's principal stood above its value (Q90).
function_v0.name: allocate

function_v0.doc:
Withdraws exactly `assets` from the pool (`data` as in `allocate`) straight to the
vault and debits the vault with the b-tokens the pool burned. Never gated by approval or the
protocol cap. The protocol total loses the principal taken out (Q89), and whatever of
the rest stands above the position's value (Q90).
function_v0.name: deallocate

function_v0.doc: Value of every position of `vault`: `floor(b_tokens \xc3\x97 b_rate / 1e12)` per pool, with\n`b_rate` read through `try_get_reserve`; the value last recorded for a pool that\ncannot be read. Never fails and never writes.
function_v0.name: real_assets

function_v0.doc: Anyone: reads `pool`'s reserve index for the asset and its collateral tokens again,\nstores them and emits `MarketSynced`. `InvalidData` unless `pool` is the strategy's\npool.
function_v0.name: sync_market

function_v0.doc:
One instance per pool, shared by every approved core vault. `factory` decides which
vaults may allocate; `cap_authority` alone sets the protocol cap; `keeper` alone may
call `harvest`; `pool` is the one pool accepted (Q136). `InvalidConfig` unless
`pool_factory` deployed `pool` (Q77) and `pool` has a reserve for `asset`.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Anyone: lowers `vault`'s principal in `pool`, and the protocol total by the same
amount, to the position's value at the pool's `b_rate` when that is lower, and emits
`PrincipalSynced`. Never raises it, moves no money and reports no `change`. A position
that does not exist, or a pool that cannot be read, is left as it is (Q90).
function_v0.name: sync_position

function_v0.doc:
What `deallocate(vault, data, x)` can pay right now: the smallest of the position's
value, what the pool can release with utilization staying below 100%, and the
pool's token balance. 0 when `data` is not the pool's XDR, or on any failed read.
Never writes.
function_v0.name: max_deallocate

function_v0.doc: Sum of the principal every vault has put in and not taken out (Q89).
function_v0.name: total_allocated

function_v0.doc: Cap authority only. 0 removes the cap.
function_v0.name: set_protocol_cap
